caveats: Nested spans overlap: do not sum stages to obtain end-to-end latency.
Counter times are accumulated across calls/threads; p50/p95 describe counter lifetimes, not individual rows.
Diagnostic GPU synchronization changes scheduling; measure performance separately with profiling disabled.
Recall and SQL client wall time must be measured by the workload; they are not inferred from these logs.
Missing GPU stages mean unobserved GPU execution, not zero GPU time.

process_resources.note: process-wide snapshots over retained records; not exclusive per-stage usage

workload.label: final-host-pq
caveats: SQL latencies include mysql CLI startup and connections.
Rounds create new tables/indexes; observer/context/OS caches are not reset.
batch_knn rebuilds an index per call in the current implementation; its QPS includes this work.
GPU execution must be verified against source profile/trace records.
Profile-enabled timings are diagnostic, not official performance scores.
